step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features Amazon EKS at the center surrounded by Fidelity's custom internal tools and identity components. EKS Manager provisions compute, network, storage, and security infrastructure into EKS. Bootstrapper sets up namespaces, connects Kubernetes RBAC to AWS IAM, which federates with Active Directory. EKS Connect serves as a secure CLI wrapper around kubectl for application deployment into EKS.

graph.name: Fidelity Investments - Extending EKS for Enterprise Scale
graph.notes: Fidelity created EKS Manager, Bootstrapper, and EKS Connect to govern, secure, and streamline Kubernetes cluster management at scale.

nodes.name: EKS Manager
nodes.notes: Custom tool wrapping CloudFormation to provision compute, network, storage, and IAM resources for EKS

nodes.name: Bootstrapper
nodes.notes: Custom CRD tool that bootstraps namespaces and integrates RBAC with IAM

nodes.name: EKS Connect
nodes.notes: Go-based wrapper around kubectl ensuring authenticated user/CI/CD deployment access

nodes.name: Active Directory
nodes.notes: Enterprise Active Directory backend for user identity federation

edges.notes: EKS Manager provisions compute, network, storage, and security components in EKS
Bootstrapper configures namespaces and CRDs in EKS
Bootstrapper links Kubernetes RBAC roles to AWS IAM roles
IAM federates user authentication with Active Directory
EKS Connect authenticates developers/pipelines and applies manifests to EKS namespaces
